alex.kim: Heads up — external audit next week. Need to propose reducing partner SIEM export retention for high-cardinality debug traces to 7 days while keeping 90 days internally. What's the safest way to minimize exposure in exported artifacts (redact vs envelope-encrypt + RBAC)?

maria.chen: You mean the nightly bundle we push to the partner?

alex.kim: Yes. They only need alerts & metadata, not raw stack traces or user identifiers. Right now the pipeline zips raw events.
